controls.name: Tabs
controls.purpose: A tab strip bound to a key; the active tab's content is yours to render. Roving arrow keys, scroll-into-view of the active tab, closable tabs and a phone-only tab are built in.
controls.replaces: hand-rolled button rows with an active class
controls.mobile: Wraps by default; add tabs--scroll to slide sideways, and tab--phone-only for a tab that exists only on a phone.
